result.title: CADMAGEDDON: High-Fidelity CAD Reconstruction with Local Inference
result.summary: CAD practitioners often work with proprietary parts that they are unwilling to share with external services. For individuals and small companies, bringing this work in-house also requires computational resources they can afford. We introduce CADMAGEDDON, an open-source agent that reconstructs editable CAD from meshes and can run locally on single-GPU systems and current-generation laptops. The method decomposes this complex task into a chain of simple visual decisions about what to construct and what to correct. Geometric tools support precise construction, allowing the agent to focus on visual reasoning. Using the mid-sized Qwen3.8-27B model, CADMAGEDDON outperforms prior approaches, including systems based on frontier models, in reconstruction quality on all the main benchmarks. CADMAGEDDON integrates with FreeCAD, bringing its reconstructions into practitioners' existing CAD workflows. Code: https://github.com/kulibinai/cadmageddon

AI.brief_summary: 提出开源 agent CADMAGEDDON，从 mesh 重建可编辑 CAD，可在单 GPU 或笔记本上本地运行；方法将任务拆成关于「构造什么、修正什么」的一串简单视觉决策，由几何工具负责精确构造，基于中等规模 Qwen3-27B 在主要基准上优于含前沿模型基线的方案。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「视觉判断交由模型、精确几何构造交由工具」的分工，可能为 LVR 中 latent 视觉推理与外部计算、证据校验之间的边界划分提供参照；决策链是否形成可核查的中间状态与停止信号值得进一步查看。
